text:
elaine: Heads-up — customer GlobalDocs wants us to onboard 2 locale-heavy models but they insisted on a pinned version for 60–90 days. Can we align on an onboarding bench slice and an escape hatch for cutover?

mohit: Do we have their SLA numbers? specifically p95 latency targets and throughput per tenant?

sarah-pm: They asked for p95 < 220ms (token step) on dedicated and < 350ms on hosted for 95% of requests. Throughput: ~8 qps steady per tenant, spikes to 25 qps for short windows. They will accept a 90-day pin window with rollback credits.

elaine: OK. Proposal:
- Benchmark slice: 1k samples per locale (es, fr, de, ja) + 500 edge-case prompts (legal docs).
- Acceptance gates: perf (p95), accuracy (BLEU/ROUGE delta <= 3 pts vs baseline), and hallucination spot-checks (sampled eval).
- Pin concession: allow 90-day pin but require opt-in to auto-quantized fallback after 30 days if unit cost > 2x baseline.

frank-sre: Capacity note: if we keep pinned full FP models per-tenant we need X GPUs reserved. We should propose a soft fallback policy: if model CPU/GPU saturation > 75% for >5m then route to fallback variant. Also need a canary window (24h) in target region.

nina-se: For the accuracy gate we need the exact eval set and scoring script. I'm attaching quick-run command to reproduce bench slice locally:

```
rbench run --model redwood/t-legal-7b --cohort globaldocs --samples 1000 --locales es,fr,de,ja --edge-samples 500 --metrics bleu,rouge,ppp
```

mohit: That CLI looks good. For the fallback variant, can we use a 4-bit quantized variant v1.1-q4a with known perf profile? If latency delta is within +30ms p95, customer may accept.

elaine: Agreed. Let's explicitly list launch criteria in one place so sales/legal have something concrete. Draft below — please edit inline: 
1) Bench slice executed and results uploaded to benchboard (perf + accuracy).
2) p95 latency < 220ms on dedicated infra and < 350ms hosted (measured with real traffic replay).
3) Accuracy within tolerance: BLEU/ROUGE delta <= 3 pts; no critical hallucination failures in spot-check.
4) Canaries passed: 24h regional canary at 10% traffic.
5) Pin contract signed with rollback credits & automatic fallback clauses.

frank-sre: Add infra items: GC drain plan, autoscale window set to 30s, and alert (p95 > 300ms or saturation > 80%). Also add a rollback playbook with contact list.

sarah-pm: I'll send the legal pin contract draft once the bench results land. Sales asked for a comms timeline: 2 business days after canary for customer cutover.

ci-bot: Canary job queued: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/globaldocs/5279012345 — runs nightly for 3 nights :eyes:

nina-se: Action items I can pick up: generate eval sets (due EOD +2), add bench CI job to run as replay (due EOD +3).

mohit: I'll scope capacity delta and draft the fallback variant perf matrix (due EOD +4).

elaine: Thanks — I'll collate everything into a single onboarding checklist and share with sales/legal. Can we aim to have bench results and canary run started by next Wed? :thumbsup: 

frank-sre: +1. If anyone needs reserved GPUs for the canary ping me and I'll allocate a temporary pool.

sarah-pm: Noted. Last thing — customer requested an explicit migration path after pin ends. Let's put a proposal into the contract: 30-day opt-in for extended pin at tiered pricing, otherwise automatic migration to latest compatible variant with a 7-day notice.

elaine: Good call. I'll add that. Closing loop: owners list -> nina (evals), mohit (capacity + fallback matrix), frank-sre (infra + rollback), sarah-pm (contract/comms), elaine (checklist + cutover coordination).

mohit: sounds good. ping me in #eng-runtime if bench starts flaking.

elaine: thanks all — we'll reconvene after the first canary run (thread will update).
